# Employment First Massachusetts

> Employment First Massachusetts provides comprehensive training, certification, and resources to advance competitive integrated employment for individuals with disabilities across Massachusetts.

Employment First Massachusetts is a statewide initiative supported by the Institute for Community Inclusion and Massachusetts Department of Developmental Services. The organization offers professional development, technical assistance, and evidence-based practices for employment service providers, families, and individuals with disabilities seeking meaningful work.

## Key Topics

- Employment First framework
- Competitive integrated employment
- Supported employment
- Job coaching
- Person-centered planning
- Career planning
- CESP and ACRE certifications
- Assistive technology
- ADA compliance and accommodations
- Social Security work incentives
- Community-based day supports
- School-to-work transition
- LifeCourse framework
- Technical assistance
- Disability services

## Training & Professional Development

- [Training Programs](https://employmentfirstma.org/training): Training programs and professional development courses via webinars and self-paced learning
- [Upcoming Events](https://employmentfirstma.org/events): Upcoming training courses, certification programs, and employment services events
- [Certifications](https://employmentfirstma.org/training/certifications): CESP and ACRE certification options for employment support professionals
- [Training Resources](https://employmentfirstma.org/training/resources): Employment training resources for direct support roles and disability services providers
- [Technical Assistance](https://employmentfirstma.org/training/ta): Technical assistance for employment services and community-based day supports providers

## Employment Practices & Frameworks

- [Quality Employment Practices](https://employmentfirstma.org/pages/quality-employment-practices): Career planning and person-centered employment practices for job seekers with disabilities
- [School-to-Work Transition](https://employmentfirstma.org/pages/transition-from-school-to-work): School-to-work transition resources for youth with disabilities and family engagement
- [Community-Based Day Supports](https://employmentfirstma.org/pages/community-based-day-supports): Service provider guide for community-based day supports and employment-first integration
- [LifeCourse in Action](https://employmentfirstma.org/lifecourseinaction): Charting the LifeCourse framework webinar series for family support and life planning

## Accessibility & Legal Resources

- [ADA Employment Rights](https://employmentfirstma.org/pages/ada): ADA employment rights, employer compliance, and workplace accommodations for disabilities
- [Accommodations & Compliance](https://employmentfirstma.org/pages/acc): ADA compliance, reasonable accommodations, and assistive technology workplace resources
- [Assistive Technology & Remote Support](https://employmentfirstma.org/pages/tech_rs): Remote employment support, assistive technology, and job coaching resources

## Benefits & Support Resources

- [Social Security Work Incentives](https://employmentfirstma.org/pages/bens): Social Security benefits, work incentives, and SSI/SSDI planning for employed individuals
- [Resource Library](https://employmentfirstma.org/pages/resource_lib): Resource library for supported employment, job coaching, and inclusive employment best practices
- [Transportation Resources](https://employmentfirstma.org/pages/transportation): Massachusetts transportation resources for disability access and employment travel training
